decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used for the external surfaces of the extension shall match those used on the existing property, and no development shall take place until samples of the materials have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out only in accordance with the approved details of materials.

Condition : 3 - The garage shown on the submitted drawing 557/1A received 31st January 2006 shall be used as and shall be retained as a domestic garage and shall not be used to provide additional living accommodation without the prior consent of the Local Planning Authority; similarly the hardstanding in front of the garage shall be retained for access and parking purposes only.
Condition : 4 - No additional openings shall be provided in the roof or external walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey garage extension to side of house.
